counterevidence_searched: Inspected CPacket::ReadInt (+0x973240) to verify m_bOverflowed at +0x24 is a 1-byte bool (with uninitialized padding at +0x25..+0x27) and confirmed draining occurs only when orig handler returns true, bOverflowed == 0, and (uiEnd - uiRead) == 4.
negative_control: Standard 5-byte 0x6f responses (uiEnd - uiRead == 0) and overflowed or malformed packets (bOverflowed != 0 or remaining != 4) are left untouched without calling CPacket::ReadInt.

obligations.description: Verify exact 15-byte prologue at k2_x64.dll + 0x8CD7C0 and, after original 0x6f handler returns true, drain the optional 4-byte remainingReconnectMs trailer via CPacket::ReadInt when 1-byte m_bOverflowed (+0x24) == 0 and (m_uiEnd - m_uiRead) == 4.
